paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training set.
model_annotation:
Here's an annotation for the provided line plots, adhering to the requested guidelines:

Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps," which is linear and ranges from 0 to 500. The x-axis tick labels are regularly spaced every 100 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards," and it is linear, ranging from 0 to 0.4. Tick labels are regularly spaced every 0.1.

The top plot illustrates the training rewards of multiple models over a series of steps on the "Easy" training set. There are three lines displayed: a blue line with a circle marker and a solid line style, a teal line with a triangle marker and a solid line style, and a red line with a diamond marker and a solid line style, corresponding to the labels "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," and "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" respectively. The blue line begins at approximately 0.2 at step 0 and reaches approximately 0.35 at step 500. The teal line begins at approximately 0.21 at step 0 and reaches approximately 0.32 at step 500. The red line begins at approximately 0.2 at step 0 and reaches approximately 0.34 at step 500.

The bottom plot illustrates the training rewards of multiple models over a series of steps on the "Hard" training set. There are two lines displayed: a blue line with circle markers and a solid line style and a red line with diamond markers and a solid line style, corresponding to the labels "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" respectively. The blue line begins at approximately 0.04 at step 0 and reaches approximately 0.18 at step 500. The red line begins at approximately 0.03 at step 0 and reaches approximately 0.20 at step 500.
